name: nvke
description: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE). A management plane for GPU Kubernetes on bare metal.
one_liner: Software that lets a company turn its own pile of NVIDIA GPU machines into a private, self-service 'cloud' that teams can request computing clusters from, instead of renting from Amazon or Google.
buyer: A platform engineer at a company that owns or leases its own GPU hardware and wants to allocate it to internal teams or resell it, like a mini cloud provider.
business_use_cases: A GPU colocation or bare-metal hosting company uses it as the control plane to offer customers self-service Kubernetes clusters on dedicated GPUs.
An AI startup that bought its own GPU cluster uses it to carve out isolated environments for different research teams instead of paying AWS/GCP prices.
A systems integrator sells a 'private GPU cloud in a box' installation and setup service to enterprises that don't want to depend on public cloud GPU rentals.

money_ideas.idea: Installation and managed-operations retainer for companies standing up a private GPU cluster on it
One-off integration project wiring it into a client's existing GPU hardware

steal_this: Pitch a 'stand up your own private GPU cloud this weekend' consulting package to an AI startup that just bought GPU hardware and is dreading the cloud bill.
